description: HushMessenger v0.23.2 for Messenger 582.0.0.61.92, all 14 arm64 builds. 54 patches. This release adds Hide People tab, Hide Notifications tab, Stop MQTT logging and Bold and italic text, keeps a reply's Seen to its own chat with Hide read receipts on, and makes settings easier to scan. Built by GitHub Actions from commit b6dfbd5efef7, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Messenger APK in CI. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Messenger APK. Source updates don't change installed apps. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
